source: ENISA Space Threat Landscape 2025, Annex C Table 17 (via Phalanx/framework/enisa_threats_tuple.csv)
name: Spoofing
description: Also known as "malicious misdirecton". Threat aimed at deceiving the receiver, seeing adversaries transmitting erroneous data for malicious purposes via what appears to be a legitimate signal. Attacks involving spoofing can be launched on sensor data and/or guidance control, that is, on both the receiver and the transmitter end. Spoofing threats can result in malicious comands being sent to the satellite or erroneous data to the ground stations.
